notes.title: 【Update Note】Spring Sale Coming! v1.7.5 Update & Optimization
notes.content:
[b]Dear Loopstructor experts, we will also release new discounts in this spring sale. Welcome to purchase and play! 

We are also pleased to bring you the update of v1.7.5, which includes a series of experience optimizations and bug fixes, aiming to bring you a better and smoother gaming experience.
[/b]
[h2]Experience optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] The unlocking order of Monster Main Base has been moved forward: We have adjusted the unlocking requirement of Monster Main Base from completion difficulty 20 to completion difficulty 16. Everyone can unlock earlier and use Monster Main Base to challenge higher difficulty.
[*] Achievement data synchronization: Achievement data related to the cumulative number of kills has now been synchronized with the kill data in the atlas.
[*] Pictorial interface optimization: When entering the game, the help interface jump button in the lower left corner will be restored.
[*] Main menu refreshed: The main menu interface restores the classic style.
[*] Super Module Improvement: The super module scattering projectile has been optimized, removing the restriction that new shells do not have elemental effects. Now, you can fully unleash elemental power and create more genre combinations in battle. It also fixed the issue where the "acceleration" collaborative module in the shell tank group could not take effect.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pick-up train interaction issue: Fixed the issue where the ejection prompt was left on the field due to pick-up train interaction under specific conditions.
[*] Bullet locking issue: Fixed the issue where new shells created by scattering projectiles would lock onto friendly units.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems or have any suggestions during the game, please join the  Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz]https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz[/url] for feedback.
Wish you a happy gaming experience!

notes.title: [Announcement] New game "Shrink Rooms" has been announced! Add to wishlist!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! Our brand-new indie game - "Shrink Rooms" Steam page has been open! 

In "Shrink Rooms", you'll embark on an extraordinary adventure in mysterious shrinking spaces. Get ready to solve mind-bending puzzles and uncover secrets that lie within these unique rooms.
[previewyoutube=y7RqOZ1ssv4;full][/previewyoutube]
Our team has been working hard to create this immersive experience for all of you. We can't wait to share more details in the future!
Add to your wishlist now to stay updated, which is very important for us. Or join our Discord channel to get more information about this game![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409430/_/

You can join our Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/JnQHZdyjsr]https://discord.gg/JnQHZdyjsr[/url]

[h1]About this game[/h1]
[b]Round-based Sokoban & Escape From Danger[/b]

The basic gameplay of Shrink Rooms is to solve puzzles by pushing boxes. 

Different from other puzzle games, the walls of the level's room will contract inward at the end of each round. You must accurately plan the number of steps for pushing boxes to escape from the secret room, so as to avoid being crushed into a puddle of flesh by the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/628a70fe47f44df1afb63d812be705459f387697.jpg[/img]


[b]Massive Mechanisms & Creative Combinations[/b]

There are various interesting mechanisms in the shrink rooms. The characteristics of different mechanisms are combined to generate many puzzles with rich variations and high difficulty. Welcome to challenge!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/7c21c9aff5cbc528ee59f7e48b22cc8aa086592b.jpg[/img]

[b]Flexible Selection & Free Exploration[/b]

You can move freely in the selection scene. You can choose easier puzzles to continue the game, or try to solve all difficult puzzles.

At the same time, in addition to solving puzzles, you can also explore and collect virtual exhibits and find hidden levels in the scene to explore different fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/c5ef249a826626013adaf43c82c21f9e9e71d385.jpg[/img]

[b]Game features[/b]
- 200+ levels.
- 4 themed chapters.
- X + exhibits with unique drawings and descriptions.
